Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. that they are not blacklisted in any Govt. organization/ PSU. 5. Bidder should quote the items as per requirement attached in the bid document. Anti Ra bies Vaccine Vial-27,00,000 nos. 6. Bidder should upload up to date Drug License from concerned State Drug Control Authori ty, If Bidder is a authorized dealer or distributor. 7. At the time of supply Bidder should submit NABL and In house Test report of supplied dru gs/medicines for each batch. 8. All the bidders are required to supply the product(s) with printed text GOVT. SUPPLY, NO T FOR SALE in indelible ink on the each strip and also on the external packings. 9. Bidder should upload duly signed specification compliance statement. 10. All the legal disputes that may arise in the future course of action, in regards to this Ge M bid, shall invariably be initiated before the Court of law within the jurisdiction of the buye r i.e West District, Tripura. 11. Turnover Criteria- Minimum average annual turnover of the bidder is ₹50 Lakh during t he last 3 financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) on an average. CA certified turnove r certificate and audited balance sheets must be submitted. 12. Experience Certificate- The bidder must have experience in supply of at least 22,000 no s. ARV Vaccine to Government Departments/PSUs/Registered Hospitals during the last 3 F.Y (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). Relevant purchase/ supply orders of GeM must be enclosed . 13. Market Standing Certificate- The quoted product should have a minimum 3 years mark et standing in India for similar use/application. Supporting documents such as supply orders , market standing certificate, or regulatory approval history must be submitted. 14. Cold Chain Compliance- The supplier must maintain proper cold chain conditions during storage and transportation of vaccines and provide temperature log records if required by t he purchaser. 15. Bidder should upload bank solvency certificate of at least Rs.50 lakh from any nationali zed bank. 16. L-1 Bidder should supply the whole consignment at their own cost and accordingly colle ct the satisfactory report of receive copy . 17. Shelf life- The item must have 24 month shelf life and during supply the item should ha ve 3/4 th of shelf life as per drug & cosmetic rule. 18. Bidder should follow ATC for detail specification and should comply with this. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of State Health & Family Welfare Society Tripura payable at Agartala . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy

to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of State Health & Family Welfare Society Tripura payable at Agartala . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
